decisions.statement: A token within sixty seconds of expiry is treated as expired.
A token answer naming no refresh token leaves the stored refresh token in place.
A refresh answering with no refresh token at all throws.
A token answer naming no scope leaves the stored scopes in place.
An expiry is written as an instant rather than as seconds remaining.
Every refreshed token is written to the token store before the token is given back.
No stored token throws and names the consent command.
Nothing here asks Alan for consent.
Every POST to the token endpoint is made from here.

definition: an access token good right now, refreshed when it is not
